packages.title: reader chosen by file extension, on by default (the user's decisions of 2026-10-10), and four findings of the final review
packages.brief: Read reports/E13-campaign/extension-default-brief.md in full: it is the contract (entries Z1 to Z7, tests, gates, report). It changes the design of reports/E13-campaign/input-format-brief.md and reports/E13-campaign/input-format-fixes-brief.md in three places: the content detector is removed, the default is auto by file extension, an HTML paragraph is one line. PRIMER.md names the third registered exception: with the default reader the numbers for .md, .markdown, .html and .htm files differ from 1.1.5, and the guardrail pins the plain reader. In `notes` report one line per entry Z1 to Z7, the existing tests whose expectation changed, and the readings of the new check.
packages.verify_note: the brief of this package is reports/E13-campaign/extension-default-brief.md. Check each entry Z1 to Z7 and each item. Probe the extension rule yourself (upper case, a.md.txt, a folder, a missing file, raw text that ends in .md, Path against str) and the default on .md, .html, .txt and raw text. Confirm that `--input-format plain` on the .md fixtures equals 1.1.5 (the baseline line) and that the default path differs from it only as the new check reports. Probe `html_to_markdown` with paragraphs wrapped over several lines and with a head that is not closed. Reproduce DEF-DEPS-17-1 with the two Hub-style tokenizer files from the cache snapshot and confirm that `init` repairs the folder or raises the named error, never a TypeError at the first split. `grep -rn detect_format` over src, tests, docs, README.md, CHANGELOG.md and .claude/skills must print nothing. A design element the brief does not ask for is a finding. No network request: HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1.
